_comment: Full-node reference roof for the heterogeneous one-rank-per-node sweep: AMD EPYC 7302P, 16 cores, 3.0 GHz base clock, and eight DDR4-3200 channels. Only p=4 and p=8 used homogeneous EPYC 7302P allocations, so this is a reference rather than a common roof for every point.
_comment_fma: Zen 2 can execute two 256-bit AVX2 FMAs per core per cycle. Each vector holds 8 fp32 values and each FMA counts as 2 FLOPs, giving a theoretical 1536 GFLOP/s for 16 cores at 3.0 GHz.
